title: Blood-C — Survival, Reproduction, Illusion #Shorts
description:
The bleak reading of Blood-C is also the most testable one. Blood-C (stylized in all caps) is a 2011 Japanese anime television series co-created by studio Production I.G and manga artist group CLAMP. The original 12-episode series aired during 2011, with a sequel film, Blood-C: The Last Dark releasing in Japanese theaters the following year.

The story Blood-C tells about itself is the last thing to be trusted. The opening theme "Spiral" was performed by Dustz, who worked hard to make the song a suitable addition to the Blood canon and incorporated both Japanese and French lyrics. The ending theme, "Junketsu Paradox", was sung by Nana Mizuki—the voice actress for Saya—who used the anime's story as inspiration and incorporated archaic phrases for the lyrics.
